title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for fast on-device agents
hook_text: Liquid AI just dropped LFM2 point 5 twenty 4B.
script:
Liquid AI just released LFM2 point 5 twenty 4B A2B for fast on-device agents.
The team built this architecture specifically for running local workflows on edge hardware.
This version packs twenty-four billion parameters into a compact size.
It succeeds the earlier LFM models by optimizing memory usage during real-time tasks.
Developers can execute complex multi-step reasoning locally without relying on cloud servers.
Will you deploy LFM2 point 5 on your local device?
